Abdallah Al-Fakhori.note: Al-Fakhouri sits behind the starter for Jordan, but the role is not decorative. He has to be ready for crosses, restarts, and a cold first touch.
Abdallah Al-Fakhori.noteZh: 他给Jordan保留另一个门将选择。真正需要他时，重点可能就是一次大扑救。

Abdallah Nasib.note: Nasib has been part of Jordan's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Abdallah Nasib.noteZh: 他给Jordan后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.note: Alnadi is back-line insurance for Jordan. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.noteZh: 他给Jordan那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Husam Abu Dahab.note: Dahab gives Jordan another way to protect the edge of the box. His value shows up when the obvious pass disappears.
Husam Abu Dahab.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha gives Jordan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: Hashish is back-line insurance for Jordan. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq is the forward Jordan can use when the match needs new legs. His first job is to make tired defenders turn.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 他给Jordan替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Yazan Al-Arab.note: Al-Arab gives Jordan one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 他是Jordan无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Al-Daoud gives Jordan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: 他是Jordan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Ali Azaizeh.note: Azaizeh gives Jordan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Ali Azaizeh.noteZh: 他是Jordan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Ali Olwan.note: Olwan already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Austria. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Ali Olwan.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.note: Mardi gives Jordan a different attacking speed from the bench. The important touch may be the run that opens space for someone else.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.noteZh: 他是Jordan在比赛需要新腿时可以使用的前锋。第一项工作，是让疲劳的后卫转身。

Noor Al-Rawabdeh.note: Al-Rawabdeh is a tempo player for Jordan. He turns crowded touches into cleaner angles for the next runner.
Noor Al-Rawabdeh.noteZh: 他让Jordan在球权转换时更有结构。最有价值的往往是松散触球之后那一秒。

Mousa Al-Taamari.note: Al-Taamari has shown both sides of the attacking job for Jordan. One action can pull the defender, and the next one can decide the chance.
Mousa Al-Taamari.noteZh: 他给Jordan展示了进攻工作的两面。一脚拉开防守，下一脚就可能决定机会。

Amer Jamous.note: Jamous is midfield insurance for Jordan. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Amer Jamous.noteZh: 他给Jordan一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Anas Badawi.note: Badawi is the kind of defender Jordan can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Anas Badawi.noteZh: 他是Jordan艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Nour Bani Attiah.note: Attiah is goalkeeper cover for Jordan. The role is readiness: saves, restarts, and no panic if the match suddenly needs him.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 他是Jordan门线上的安全网。这个工作说起来简单，做起来很难：冷着上场，并让禁区安静。

Ehsan Haddad.note: Haddad has already made a goal happen for Jordan. His value is picking the moment when the defense is still moving.
Ehsan Haddad.noteZh: 他已经为Jordan送出一次进球前的传球。重点是机会真正显眼前的那次触球。

Ibrahim Sadeh.note: Sadeh gives Jordan a way to settle the middle if the match opens up. His best work is making the next decision less hurried.

Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: Al-Rashdan already has a World Cup goal in this run, against Algeria. His card is about finding the moment before the match settles again.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: 他的世界杯已经有了进球。下一次机会也许仍来自阵型重新站稳前的那一小段时间。

Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 他给Jordan替补席上的另一种进攻速度。有时关键触球，是那次帮队友拉开空间的跑动。

Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 他是Jordan的中场保险。那些混乱阶段里，他要抢第二点、稳一下，再把球送出去。

Saed Al-Rosan.note: Al-Rosan is defensive cover for Jordan's harder minutes. He is there to win the first contact and make the next pass simple.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 他是Jordan在比赛变窄时可以使用的后卫。任务是第一下接触、清楚解围、简单出球。

Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid gives Jordan cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 他是Jordan后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila is the last voice in Jordan's defensive shape. When pressure sticks, his job is to make the next action feel simple.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 他承担了Jordan的门将时间。重点是稳手、清楚开球，以及让身前后卫不用慌。
